author: smimon
text:
To my thinking, and anyone feel free to correct me, the DP you have marked at 2 (which was itself a FL on lower timeframe) was the more important level out of 1 & 2, since it was the push from 2 that broke the strong SR level. The immediate move from level 1 only broke some less important nearby levels, so it wasn't as "strong" in the scheme of things. Once 2 was engulfed (it actually got gapped over), then the next level of some importance for me would have been the next bull surge level to the left of 1, which took out a strong area of supply.

HTF engulfs give you the idea of where you are going. LTF engulfs tell you how you are going to get there, and give you good opportunities to get on board.
